app.title: F1 PIT WALL
app.tagline: Strategy assistant for F1 Manager — reads your save, suggests actions.

upload.title: Load your F1 Manager save
upload.hint: Drag & drop a .sav file here, or click to browse

meta.title: Save loaded

warnings.NO_COMPLETED_RACES: No completed races in this save — race analytics modules will be empty; factory/season modules still work.

meta.missingTables: Missing optional tables: {tables} — related modules will use fallbacks and state confidence LOW.
meta.nextPhase: Pit Wall Home + recommendations arrive in Phase 1.

library.title: Save library (this device)
library.subtitle: Parsed models are stored in IndexedDB — the raw .sav is never stored.
library.empty: No saves stored in this browser yet.
library.confirmDelete: Delete this save from the browser?

privacy.localOnly: Generated locally — no data leaves your device.
privacy.readonly: Read-only — the app never writes to or modifies your save file.
privacy.detail: All parsing runs in a Web Worker inside your browser. No upload, no server, no tracking. Delete your data anytime from the Library.

errors.title: Cannot read this save
errors.NOT_A_GVAS_SAVE: This is not an Unreal/GVAS save — pick the correct F1 Manager .sav file.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SAVE_FORMAT: Save version not supported. Supported: F1 Manager 23 and 24 (volta23/volta24 builds).
errors.MALFORMED_GVAS: The save looks truncated or corrupted. Re-save from the game or try another copy.
errors.NOT_A_SQLITE_DB: The embedded database inside the save is invalid — the save may have been written mid-way.
errors.DB_INFLATE_FAILED: Could not decompress the embedded database — the file may be corrupted.
errors.MISSING_CORE_TABLES: Save is missing mandatory tables: {tables}. This may be an unsupported game mode or stage.
errors.DB_OPEN_FAILED: Could not open the SQLite database inside the save. Try again or report the game build.
errors.NORMALIZE_FAILED: Parsed rows failed normalization — unknown schema. Please report with the game build.
errors.WORKER_ERROR: System error while parsing (worker). Reload the page and try again.
errors.FILE_READ_ERROR: Could not read the file from disk. Pick the file again.

footer.note: F1 Pit Wall — a save analysis tool that runs entirely on your machine. Not affiliated with Frontier Developments or F1.

confidence.HIGH: HIGH confidence — measured directly from the save
confidence.MEDIUM: MEDIUM confidence — derived from historical data in the save
confidence.LOW: LOW confidence — model constants used because the save lacks data
confidence.semantics: Every number has its source in the evidence section.
